time.finding: 65 applies25% inflation against an already buffered10h target, effectively requiring raw<=8h. This is more conservative than raw<=10h or raw*1.25<=12h; not the largest time-feasible count under either requested rule.

disk.caveat: Disk deltas include concurrent host activity and shared-layer effects; not guaranteed task costs. No new disk query or image fetch. Runtime reserve retained once; unknown future images may cost more than observed maximum.

frozen_order.rule: Preserve fixed10 order. Repeatedly choose remaining task minimizing current repo representation, then current within-repo difficulty representation, then SHA256(seed|repo), then SHA256(seed|instance_id). Only official instance ID/repo/difficulty metadata used; no scores, trajectories, or patch content used. Future lists are prefixes of same500 ordering.

assessment: 65 is a prepared lower bound, not demonstrated largest feasible list. Time permits85 with25%/12h margin or92 withraw10h; disk mean extrapolation does not support20/27 extra images. Existing disk guard allows at least attempting another serial preparation, so65 cannot honestly be called a measured hard disk maximum. Coordinator should either extend frozen-order prefix under disk guards until physical bound is demonstrated, or explicitly justify a conservative count with stated uncertainty; do not retrospectively claim65 is largest.
